screening_note: The synopsis says lost link; the narrative describes loss of control, failed return to home, and an unknown error.
synopsis: Part 107 UAS pilot reported after takeoff an unknown error with the UAS caused a lost link; resulting in a fly away and unsuccessful recovery.
narrative: Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS. Platform continued to fly away from me while input into the controls to return. All attempts of Return To Home features failed. UAS Platform has not been located or recovered.
